The range of expenditure incurred over the five-year period is most similar for which of the following items of expenditure?

options.text: Fuel etc and Interest on Loans

solution:
**Given:**

The table showing the details of the expenditure incurred (in Rs. crores) by a tea garden during the years 2013 to 2017 is given.

**Formula used:**

Range = maximum value - minimum value

**Calculation:**

Range of Salary = 84.0 - 60.5 = 13.5

Range of Fuel etc = 30.2 - 19.4 = 10.8

Range of Bonus = 0.96 - 0.4 = 0.56

Range of Interest on loans = 10.11 - 4.88 = 5.23

Range of Taxes = 22.6 - 16.8 = 5.8

**Therefore, The range of expenditure incurred over the five-year period is most similar for Interest on loans and Taxes.**
